verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke publishes concrete pricing pages for at least two practice areas (immigration and employment tribunal claims) with specific hourly rate ranges and fixed-fee bands, directly countering opaque billing for those services. However, there is no evidence of firm-wide statements on rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices across its broader service lines (e.g., corporate, IP, data, cyber). Missing for 10: firm-wide fee-transparency policy, explicit mention of alternative fee arrangements (AFAs), pricing disclosure for other major practice areas.
